UNSUPPORTED_SCHEMA_VERSION: Unsupported recipe schema version: {schemaVersion}. Only omrl/v0alpha1 is supported.
UNKNOWN_OPERATION: Unknown operation: {operation}. Only operations from the OMRL catalog are allowed.
INVALID_URI: Invalid virtual URI: {uri}. Allowed schemes: game://, profile://, staging://, package://.
PATH_OUT_OF_BOUNDS: Path is outside the approved area: {path}. Writes are limited to the game and profile directories.
MISSING_CAPABILITY: The recipe uses operation {operation} but does not declare the required capability {capability}.
INVALID_VERSION: Invalid version: {version}. Only numeric-dot versions are allowed, e.g. 2026.1.
UNSUPPORTED_GAME_VERSION: This game version ({gameVersion}) does not satisfy the recipe requirement ({range}).
AMBIGUOUS_TARGET: The installation target cannot be determined unambiguously: {reason}. Select a single edition or game version.
GAME_BUILD_UNAVAILABLE: The game version for this installation cannot be determined. Point to an existing installation or choose another compatible mod.
LOADER_UNAVAILABLE: The required mod loader {loader} in version {range} is not available for this installation.
ARTIFACT_MISSING: Artifact file is missing: {artifact}. Download it again or provide a local copy.
ARTIFACT_HASH_MISMATCH: The checksum of {artifact} does not match the declared value. The file may have been tampered with — installation halted.
ARTIFACT_DOWNLOAD_UNAVAILABLE: Artifact {artifact} requires a download that is not available in this version. Use a local copy with a matching checksum.
ARTIFACT_DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT: Downloading artifact {artifact} timed out. Check the connection and try again.
ARTIFACT_SIZE_MISMATCH: Artifact {artifact} has size {actual}, but {expected} bytes were expected. The download was discarded.
ARCH_MISMATCH: Artifact {artifact} is built for {artifactArch}, but this installation is {arch}. It would not load — pick a mod version for {arch} or another installation.
MOD_SOURCE_INVALID: The selected {source} mod source is incomplete or invalid: {detail}.
MOD_SOURCE_HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: The download host {host} is not approved for this mod source.
MOD_ARTIFACT_UNAVAILABLE: No downloadable variant of {artifact} matches this installation (architecture: {arch}, store: {store}). Choose another mod version or installation.
MOD_ARTIFACT_HASH_UNDECLARED: The mod artifact {artifact} has no declared SHA-256, so it cannot be verified. Installation halted — report it in the mod catalog.
MOD_COMPATIBILITY_BLOCKED: The mod {full} and the dll {dll} are marked as not working together in the compatibility table. Remove one of them from the plan.
CATALOG_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The mod catalog response signature does not match its content. The response was rejected and the previous catalog stays in use — try again or report it.
CATALOG_SIGNATURE_UNKNOWN_KEY: The mod catalog is signed with a key {keyId} this app version does not trust. The response was rejected — update Phaket or report it.
CATALOG_REVISION_STALE: The mod catalog returned revision {revision}, not newer than the cached {cached}. A stale or replayed answer was rejected and the cached catalog stays in use.
MOD_COMPATIBILITY_UNTESTED: The mod {full} and the dll {dll} have not been tested together. The installation will proceed, but the combination may not work.
ARCHIVE_INVALID: Archive {artifact} cannot be read as a valid ZIP file.
ARCHIVE_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED: Archive {artifact} uses the unsupported format {format}. Choose a ZIP archive.
PLAN_NOT_ACCEPTED: The installation plan must be reviewed and approved before files can be changed.
GITHUB_HASH_UNVERIFIED: A GitHub asset has no trusted SHA-256 checksum. Its downloaded content will be pinned in the reviewed plan, but its origin is not verified.
THUNDERSTORE_HASH_UNVERIFIED: The Thunderstore package has no SHA-256 in the API, so the download was not cryptographically verified. Its content is pinned in the reviewed plan, but its origin is not attested by the source.
ARCHIVE_UNSAFE: Archive {artifact} is unsafe: {reason}. Extraction was blocked.
OWNERSHIP_VIOLATION: File {path} does not belong to this recipe or profile. Removal was blocked.
CONFLICT_UNRESOLVABLE: The conflict on {path} between {owners} cannot be resolved automatically. Choose a mod order or remove the conflict.
FILE_CONFLICT_REQUIRES_DECISION: The file {path} changed both in the installation and in the new mod since the last agreed state. Choose which version to keep — Phaket will not overwrite either without your decision.
BASELINE_INVALID: The saved agreed state of this installation is invalid ({detail}). Rebuild the agreed state before Phaket can check file conflicts.
JOURNAL_DIVERGENCE: The installation state differs from the transaction journal. Choose to resume or restore the previous state.
BASE_GAME_MISMATCH: The game directory {path} already contains base game version {have}, but the recipe requires {need}. Switching the base version under existing mods is not available — use a separate installation or uninstall the mods first.
INSTALL_FACTS_MISSING: The recipe requires the game's {fact}, but Phaket does not know it for this installation. Choose the game build or set the architecture, then plan again.
PLAN_EMPTY: The recipe matched no steps for this installation, so there is nothing to do. No files were changed and nothing was registered as installed.
SESSION_PRIVACY_FAILED: Phaket could not secure the session directory ({path}): {detail}. The token was not saved — Phaket never stores secrets somewhere other accounts can read. Close the app and try again on a normal disk.
TOOL_OFFLINE: No network connection is available to download the tool.
TOOL_UNVERIFIED_VERSION: This version has no trusted SHA-256 hash.
BASE_GAME_MANIFEST_MISSING: No Steam manifest for game version {version} in the build registry. Sync the build registry (Builds view) or configure GITHUB_TOKEN on the server, then try again.
BASE_GAME_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: This game version needs a Steam sign-in. Sign in to Steam in the Library, then try installing the mod again.
BASE_GAME_AUTH_CANCELLED: The Steam sign-in was cancelled. Start the install again and finish signing in (password or Steam Guard code).
BASE_GAME_TIMEOUT: Downloading the game version timed out. Check the connection and try again.
BASE_GAME_TOOL_FAILED: The game version download tool failed. External tool output: {detail}
EPIC_SIGN_IN_REQUIRED: This game version needs an Epic sign-in. Sign in to Epic in the Library, then try installing the mod again.
DEPOTDOWNLOADER_DOTNET_NOT_FOUND: The .NET runtime required to run DepotDownloader was not found. Install the .NET runtime and try again.
SAVE_BACKUP_TOO_LARGE: Your saves take {size} and a backup can hold {limit}. Nothing was copied, so your saves are unchanged. Free some space or delete older backups, then try again.
SAVE_BACKUP_HASH_MISMATCH: A file in backup {id} does not match what was saved ({path}). Nothing was restored — the backup may be damaged.
SAVE_BACKUP_MANIFEST_INVALID: The backup {id} cannot be read: its description file is missing or damaged.
SAVE_BACKUP_RESTORE_REFUSED: The backup would be restored outside the save folder ({path}). Nothing was restored.
SAVE_BACKUP_PRUNE_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Deleting old backups is permanent. Confirm first that Phaket may remove them.
SAVE_BACKUP_CHANGED_DURING_COPY: The saves of {game} changed while they were being copied ({path}), so the backup would mix two states. Nothing was kept — close the game and start the install again.
DISK_FULL: Not enough disk space. {requiredMb} MB more is needed.
AURELIA_UNAVAILABLE: Aurelia is not available ({reason}), so Phaket shows the locally detected Steam games instead.
AURELIA_FAILED: Aurelia returned an error, so Phaket shows the locally detected Steam games instead: {detail}
AURELIA_AUTH_REQUIRED: Aurelia needs a Steam sign-in for this data. Sign in through Aurelia, or Phaket will keep using the locally detected games.
AURELIA_OFFLINE: Aurelia has no network connection, so Phaket shows the locally detected Steam games instead.
AURELIA_TIMEOUT: Aurelia did not finish in time, so Phaket shows the locally detected Steam games instead.
AURELIA_CANCELLED: The Aurelia operation was cancelled. Phaket shows the locally detected Steam games instead.
AURELIA_RATE_LIMITED: Steam is throttling Aurelia's requests. Phaket shows the locally detected Steam games until the limit clears.
STEAM_SHORTCUT_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Phaket needs your consent to add the shortcut to your Steam folder. Nothing was saved without it.
STEAM_SHORTCUTS_CORRUPT: The Steam shortcut file ({path}) cannot be read. Phaket left it unchanged so your other shortcuts stay safe. Start Steam so it repairs the file, then try again.
